bullets.text: Kalshi Boosts Threads Engagement - **Kalshi** integrates sharing features with **Meta’s Threads**, enhancing user interaction on prediction markets.
Pokopia Revives Nostalgia - **Nintendo**'s new **Pokédex** blends classic design with modern tech for a unique gaming experience.
Google Reverts AI Search - **Google Photos** now offers a toggle to switch back to classic search, responding to user feedback.
AI Brain Fry Study - A **Harvard Business Review** study reveals excessive AI use leads to increased mental fatigue among workers.
AirTag 2 Enhances Tracking - **Apple** expands **AirTag**'s Precision Finding feature to the **Apple Watch**, improving lost item recovery.
Studio Display XDR Update - **Apple**'s **Studio Display XDR** will soon support full calibration, enhancing color accuracy.
MacBook Neo Impresses - **Apple**'s **MacBook Neo** offers solid build quality and vibrant colors at an attractive price.
iPadOS 26.4 Improves Multitasking - **Apple** introduces a feature in **iPadOS 26.4** to manage multiple app windows more effectively.
Phil Schiller's SXSW Interview - **Apple** Fellow **Phil Schiller** will discuss the company's legacy at **SXSW** next week.
iPhone 17e Gets MagSafe - The new **iPhone 17e** now features **MagSafe**, enhancing accessory compatibility across all models.
